name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme - Technical Degree
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

rules.text: The applicant must be a girl student pursuing a technical degree.
The applicant must be admitted to a degree-level technical programme.
rules.source_clause: First year of Degree level course

rules.text: Fresh applicants may be in first year, or second year through lateral entry.
rules.source_clause: Second year of Degree level course through lateral entry

rules.text: The degree programme must be in an AICTE-approved institution.
Annual family income must not exceed INR 8 lakh.
rules.source_clause: Family income ... not more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum

name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme - Technical Degree
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

rules.text: The applicant must fall within one of the qualifying Swanath special circumstances.
Annual family income must not exceed INR 8 lakh.
rules.source_clause: annual family income ... not exceeding Rs. 8 lakh

rules.text: The applicant must study in an AICTE-approved technical programme.
This dataset entry covers the technical degree version of Swanath.
The applicant must not be receiving another government-sponsored scholarship.

name: PM YASASVI Top Class Education in College
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

rules.text: The applicant must belong to OBC, EBC or DNT category.
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed INR 2.5 lakh.
rules.source_clause: annual family income from all sources up to Rs. 2.50 lakh

rules.text: The applicant must be pursuing the prescribed full-time course covered by the scheme.
The applicant must have admission to an institution notified under the scheme.

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Scheme

rules.text: The applicant must satisfy the Maharashtra domicile / state eligibility conditions applicable to the scheme.
The applicant must have a valid Maharashtra domicile certificate.
The family annual income limit for the scheme is INR 8 lakh.
rules.source_clause: family annual income limit is up to Rs. 8.00 lakh

rules.text: The scheme covers specified professional and non-professional courses under the Directorate of Higher Education.
The institution must fall within the institution categories covered by the DHE scheme.
rules.source_clause: Government / Non-government aided / Partially Aided / Unaided

rules.text: The applicant must not be receiving another scholarship or stipend that conflicts with the scheme.
